title: IvyZen Scholarship Program
text:
IvyZen has helped students craft unique and compelling themes covering a diverse area of interests such as social entrepreneurship, applied math, AI/machine learning, political activism, computer science + art and many more. These themes have helped more than 350 students getting admissions in the top 10 IVY colleges over the span of 20+ years.

Over the years, they’ve come across many students who cannot afford their services. But they’ve taken on many such students in the form of pro bono work. To expand this work and formalize their services to such students, they’ve created the IvyZen Scholarship Program for getting into ivy league schools dedicated towards rising seniors/students with low annual family income to help them with their college applications & essays. Their scholarship program provides the following services and total more than $8,000 worth of their premium mentoring services:

  • Free one hour Customized Academic Plan (CAP) for IVY League
  • Free one hour Essay Tutorial for IVY League
  • Free one hour of Brainstorming Essays for IVY League
  • Free one hour college list Consultation for IVY League
  • Free one hour Essay Editing for IVY League

To apply, visit IvyZen Scholarship Program
